title: OCSD-XL on the paper benchmark (72 QuickDraw-Scenes): two frozen settings vs OCSD v1/v2 and baselines
stage: second confirmation: the settings, arms, tests and claim rules of assets/xl_confirm_v1, on the paper benchmark

scene_import.note: The scenes are not committed. They are copied from the paper benchmark on Drive at run time and must match the expected list; the run records whether the copied files have the dataset identity that the 2026-11-05 run recorded.

common_settings.negative_prompt: lowres, blurry, deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs, watermark, text, drawing, sketch, line art, outline, illustration, painting, cartoon, clipart, paper cutout, 3d render
common_settings.obj_negative_prompt: lowres, blurry, deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs, watermark, text, drawing, sketch, line art, outline, illustration, painting, cartoon, clipart, paper cutout, 3d render, white silhouette, blank, flat, text
common_settings.obj_prompt_tmpl: a photo of a {phrase}, realistic, detailed texture, natural colors, soft studio lighting, plain gray studio background

frozen_from.ocsd_xl_natural: xl_dev_v3 arm ocsd_xl_w04; unchanged since assets/xl_confirm_v1
frozen_from.ocsd_xl_faithful: xl_dev_v3 arm ocsd_xl_w08_noenergy; unchanged since assets/xl_confirm_v1

evaluation.sketch_fidelity: SAM outline vs raw sketch ink
evaluation.naturalness: blind analyst rating 0 / 1 / 2 on 36 sheets: the scenes numbered 003 to 005 (3 per cell, 9 per object-count bin), seed 0, every arm on each sheet in shuffled order, written before review_key.json or any table is opened

analysis.unit: scene; per-scene value = mean over seeds 0 and 1 (72 scenes) for the automatic metrics, and the seed 0 rating of the 36 reviewed scenes for naturalness
analysis.test: exact two-sided sign test over scenes; Holm over the four primary tests; paired bootstrap 95% CIs
claims: C-faithful "OCSD-XL (faithful) keeps objects better than the original OCSD": P1 or P2 has Holm p < 0.05 in its favour and neither is significantly worse.
C-natural "OCSD-XL (natural) looks more natural than the original OCSD without losing objects": P3 has Holm p < 0.05 in its favour and P4 is not significantly worse (Holm p >= 0.05 or in favour).

A claim is reported as confirmed on the paper benchmark only if it holds here. The two test sets are reported side by side and never pooled; a claim that holds on one set and not on the other is reported as such.
analysis.secondary: Both settings against ocsd_v2, xl_controlnet, xl_collage, gligen, collage, controlnet, ocsd_v3 and direct_box on OPR, mIoU, sketch chamfer, naturalness and PickScore, and the means by object-count bin: differences with bootstrap CIs and unadjusted sign tests, labelled exploratory.
analysis.tool: tools/analyze_xl_confirm.py <results> <ratings> xl_paper_v1 (unchanged since the first confirmation)

limits: The naturalness rater is the analyst who developed the settings and who has seen OCSD-XL images of other scenes; sheets are blind and shuffled, but SDXL images can be recognisable by their look.
Naturalness is rated on half of the scenes and one seed, fixed in this lock.
OCSD-XL runs without M3 (identity learning does not train on SDXL in this code); the original OCSD uses M3.
Part of any difference to the SD 1.5 methods is the backbone; xl_controlnet and xl_collage are the same-backbone references.

The 72 scenes are the evaluation scenes of results/paper_v2 and of the 2026-11-05 run: the SD 1.5 methods and OCSD v3 have been reported on them before. No OCSD-XL image of these scenes exists before this run, and no OCSD-XL setting was chosen on them.
OCSD-XL has not been run on single-object scenes before (18 of the 72).
